datastores.note: Datastore references come from static configuration (images, connection URLs, host/database settings, Terraform datastore resources); they do not prove runtime use. A shared database means the same configured database name, a shared server only the same configured server. A shared table is a table the services' own source names literally (entities, migrations, SQL); queries are not analyzed.
